title: Mismatched Libido
summary: Partners often want sex at different frequencies. It's very common and solvable through honest talk, non-pressured intimacy, scheduling, and exploring what each person needs.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
